title: How Much to Charge for Mobile Dog Grooming

facts.fact: A&A Center Trailers states that its built-to-order grooming trailers start at $13,100.
facts.quote: Our built-to-order grooming trailers start at $13,100

facts.fact: A&A Center Trailers lists its weekday business hours as Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.
facts.quote: We are open Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5 PM

facts.fact: A&A Center Trailers lists its Saturday business hours as 9 AM to 4 PM.
A&A Center Trailers gives its address as 8834 Tara Blvd, Jonesboro, GA 30236.
A&A Center Trailers lists (770) 603-8511 as its phone number and (404) 383-8194 as its text number.
The article gives the cost-per-groom formula as fixed monthly costs divided by grooms per month, plus variable cost per groom.
facts.quote: Cost per groom = (fixed monthly costs ÷ grooms per month) + variable cost per groom

facts.fact: The article recommends reviewing mobile grooming prices at least once a year as costs change.
facts.quote: Review your prices at least once a year as costs change.
